ai: Please put your phone away and come here at once.
請馬上把手機收起來，立刻過來。
The students all started talking at once.
學生們立刻全都開始講話。
If you smell gas, leave the house at once.
如果你聞到瓦斯味，要立刻離開房子。
This is by far the best pizza I have ever eaten.
這絕對是我吃過最好吃的披薩。
She is by far the tallest girl in our class.
她遠遠是我們班上最高的女生。
By far the biggest problem is the lack of time.
最大的問題絕對是時間不夠。
He moved abroad for good after he got married.
他結婚後就永遠搬到國外了。
I quit sugar for good last year.
我去年徹底戒掉了糖。
They hope to fix the leak for good this time.
這次他們希望能一勞永逸地修好漏水。
I don't know for sure when the train leaves.
我不確定火車什麼時候開。
She will come to the party for sure.
她一定會來參加派對。
Nobody can say for sure what will happen next.
沒有人能確定接下來會發生什麼事。
My brother and I have a lot in common.
我哥哥和我有很多共同點。
The two cities have little in common.
這兩個城市幾乎沒有共同點。
What do you and your new roommate have in common?
你和你的新室友有什麼共同點？
The old house is in need of repair.
這棟老房子需要修繕。
Many families in the town are in need of help.
鎮上有許多家庭需要幫助。
I am in need of a long, quiet vacation.
我很需要一個又長又安靜的假期。
On average, I sleep about seven hours a night.
平均來說，我每晚睡大約七小時。
Students here spend two hours on homework on average.
這裡的學生平均每天花兩小時寫作業。
Prices went up by three percent on average.
物價平均上漲了百分之三。
Your English will get better over time.
你的英文會隨著時間慢慢進步。
Over time, the paint on the wall began to fade.
久而久之，牆上的油漆開始褪色。
Small savings can grow into a lot over time.
小額儲蓄久而久之能累積成一大筆錢。
Can you take a look at my essay?
你可以看一下我的作文嗎？
Let's take a look at the menu before we order.
我們點餐前先看一下菜單吧。
The doctor will take a look at your knee tomorrow.
醫生明天會看一下你的膝蓋。
It is hard to make a decision when you are tired.
累的時候很難做決定。
We need to make a decision about the trip by Friday.
我們必須在週五前決定旅行的事。
Take your time, but please make a decision before dinner.
慢慢來，但請在晚餐前做出決定。
